main_body: Round leafy canopy (about rows 1-29) on a single brown trunk (rows 30-45) with a dark green ground shadow patch at the base
top_band: Canopy top at x=12: dark outline rows 1-2, then mid green #254a32 and #34633c over rows 3-7, with lighter clumps (#49804c, #689e63) lower in the canopy. The canopy reads as a domed mass seen from above and slightly in front.
evidence: This is an organic tree, so the contract is read loosely. The canopy is a rounded clumped dome with highlighted upper lobes and a dark underside row (row 29 outline) above the trunk, and the trunk is a vertical south face about 14 rows tall. No receding side face is drawn and it is not a flat elevation. A thin front edge line is absent, but the canopy shading and underside shadow read as a top surface over a front.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 11 distinct colours and a median of 9 colours per tile, against 427-567 colours and about 108 per tile for the references. It has five green steps with a tinted dark green outline (0% neutral edge pixels) and no flat 5x5 fills. The canopy is built from a few large smooth lobes with little leaf-level texture. The trunk is a flat brown column with minimal grain. Both references have dense leaf clumps, branches and bark detail. Next to them the candidate is much thinner and more simplified.
